# Physics tests: simulations against analytic solutions, in physical units with the Setup API (ctest -L physics; GPU).
# Each test builds like an example (the core with its own defines.hpp, generated by fluidx3d_configure_defines() with
# the extensions it needs) and prints "PHYSICS <check>: ... PASSED" or "... FAILED" (physics_check.hpp).

# fluidx3d_add_physics_test(<name> [SOURCE <file stem>] [EXTENSIONS <defines...>] [TIMEOUT <seconds>])
#   Builds tests/physics/<name>.cpp (or <SOURCE>.cpp: one test built with other extensions, e.g. SCALAR_FV) into
#   bin/physics_<name> and registers the CTest test physics_<name>.
function(fluidx3d_add_physics_test name)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 1 ARG "" "TIMEOUT;SOURCE" "EXTENSIONS")
    if(NOT ARG_TIMEOUT)
        set(ARG_TIMEOUT 300)
    endif()
    if(NOT ARG_SOURCE)
        set(ARG_SOURCE ${name})
    endif()
    set(defines_dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name})
    fluidx3d_configure_defines(${defines_dir} EXTENSIONS ${ARG_EXTENSIONS})

    _fluidx3d_add_executable(physics_${name} ${defines_dir} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${ARG_SOURCE}.cpp)
    target_include_directories(physics_${name}_setup PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}) # physics_check.hpp

    add_test(NAME physics_${name} COMMAND physics_${name} WORKING_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/bin)
    set_tests_properties(physics_${name} PROPERTIES
        LABELS "physics;gpu"
        PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "PHYSICS [^\n]* PASSED"
        FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "PHYSICS [^\n]* FAILED"
        TIMEOUT ${ARG_TIMEOUT}
        RUN_SERIAL TRUE
    )
endfunction()

fluidx3d_add_physics_test(poiseuille EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(stokes_drag EXTENSIONS FORCE_FIELD EQUILIBRIUM_BOUNDARIES)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(taylor_green)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(hydrostatic EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(sdf_domains)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(domains_flow EXTENSIONS FP16S EQUILIBRIUM_BOUNDARIES SUBGRID)
# The convection extensions of this fork (research/convection/README.md). Each test runs in seconds to a few minutes.
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(heat_source EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(eddy_heat_diffusivity EXTENSIONS EQUILIBRIUM_BOUNDARIES TEMPERATURE SUBGRID)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(thermal_diffusivity EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE)
# The same test with THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX: alpha is the diffusivity
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(thermal_diffusivity_fix SOURCE thermal_diffusivity EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX)
# The Setup API gives the core the alpha that makes it diffuse with the fluid's diffusivity, in all three builds
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(thermal_diffusivity_api EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(thermal_diffusivity_api_fix SOURCE thermal_diffusivity_api EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(thermal_diffusivity_api_fv SOURCE thermal_diffusivity_api EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX SCALAR_FV)
# An atmosphere through the Setup API: the time step rule, the given diffusivities, the Boussinesq buoyancy
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(atmosphere_setup EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX)
# The atmosphere's middle layer gives the verified CBL example's set-up (its FINGERPRINT) on the golden cases; like the
# example, its own code without fast math (cmake/configs.cmake)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(atmosphere_column EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE SUBGRID THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX LEVEL_FORCING MOISTURE SCALAR_FV)
set_target_properties(physics_atmosphere_column_setup PROPERTIES FLUIDX3D_PRECISE_FLOAT ON)
target_include_directories(physics_atmosphere_column_setup PRIVATE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit) # golden_capture.hpp
target_compile_definitions(physics_atmosphere_column_setup PRIVATE FLUIDX3D_GOLDEN_DIR="${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/golden")
# ... and its runs give the example's profiles.csv byte for byte
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(atmosphere_profiles EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE SUBGRID THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX LEVEL_FORCING MOISTURE SCALAR_FV TIMEOUT 900)
set_target_properties(physics_atmosphere_profiles_setup PROPERTIES FLUIDX3D_PRECISE_FLOAT ON)
target_include_directories(physics_atmosphere_profiles_setup PRIVATE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit) # golden_capture.hpp
target_compile_definitions(physics_atmosphere_profiles_setup PRIVATE FLUIDX3D_GOLDEN_DIR="${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/golden")
# The per-level forcing: the wind nudging, the sponge's damping and temperature relaxation, two domains against one
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(level_forcing EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE LEVEL_FORCING)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(level_forcing_fix SOURCE level_forcing EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX LEVEL_FORCING)
# The moisture: the budget and the halo exchange, the virtual-temperature buoyancy
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(moisture_source EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE MOISTURE)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(moist_buoyancy EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX SUBGRID LEVEL_FORCING MOISTURE)
# The same tests with SCALAR_FV (heat and water by finite volumes), a moist thermal against its dry twin (SCALAR_FV only:
# the D3Q7 moisture lattice does not keep a uniform qt uniform), and the heat budget with buoyancy
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(heat_source_fv SOURCE heat_source EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX SCALAR_FV)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(thermal_diffusivity_fv SOURCE thermal_diffusivity EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX SCALAR_FV)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(eddy_heat_diffusivity_fv SOURCE eddy_heat_diffusivity EXTENSIONS EQUILIBRIUM_BOUNDARIES TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX SUBGRID SCALAR_FV)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(level_forcing_fv SOURCE level_forcing EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX LEVEL_FORCING SCALAR_FV)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(moisture_source_fv SOURCE moisture_source EXTENSIONS TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX MOISTURE SCALAR_FV)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(moist_buoyancy_fv SOURCE moist_buoyancy EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX SUBGRID LEVEL_FORCING MOISTURE SCALAR_FV)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(moist_bubble_fv SOURCE moist_bubble EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX SUBGRID LEVEL_FORCING MOISTURE SCALAR_FV TIMEOUT 900)
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(heat_conservation_fv SOURCE heat_conservation EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX SUBGRID SCALAR_FV TIMEOUT 900)
# SCALAR_FV across domains: 2 along x, 2 along y and 2 x 2 bit-identical to one domain
fluidx3d_add_physics_test(scalar_fv_domains EXTENSIONS VOLUME_FORCE TEMPERATURE THERMAL_DIFFUSIVITY_FIX SUBGRID MOISTURE SCALAR_FV)
